images.title: A hexagon cluster
images.purpose: Show 1 centre dot with a ring of 6 dots, and the next ring of 12, giving 7 and then 19 dots.
images.composition: Concentric rings centred on a white page, one sum line below.
images.exact_structure: One centre dot in reddish purple #CC79A7. Around it a ring of exactly 6 dots in teal #0072B2 on a hexagon, evenly spaced. Around that, a larger ring of exactly 12 dots in amber #E69F00 on a hexagon, evenly spaced, all dots the same size, a thin grey #6B7280 hexagon outline through each ring. Below, centred, the sums. Exactly 19 dots.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any ring with a different number of dots
rings that are not centred on the same dot
images.takeaway: Count the cluster so far, then add the whole new ring.
images.description: A centre dot, a ring of 6 dots and a ring of 12 dots making 19 dots.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count each ring and say how the total grows from 7 to 19.

image_decisions.why: Rings in distinct colours keep a 19-dot picture countable.
